correctness.rationale: The bracket is a volume form on the three-dimensional quotient with central output. The U-component of the defining identity forces the upper-right block u to vanish. The remaining identity is exactly t(adj(A)+I)=det(A)I. Its t=0 branch is all singular A; for t nonzero, adj(A) scalar forces A invertible and scalar, yielding t(lambda^2+1)=lambda^3. The bottom covector is absent from every bracket equation. Direct finite-field replay over F2 agrees with the classification, and the arXiv-v1 diagonal family has defect k(1-2k)e4 on a basis triple.
